title: make install symlinks short dir names; collides with catalog org.sysc.* install paths
description: From GitHub issue Nomadcxx/sysc-plugins#12 (N7, medium). Makefile install target symlinks plugins/<dir> (e.g. timer) into USER_PLUGIN_ROOT (~/.config/sysc-shell/plugins/<dir>), but manifest ids are org.sysc.timer etc. and catalog installs use the full id as the directory name. If both trees exist, discover sees duplicate plugin IDs and rejects both, making the plugin disappear. Remediation options per issue: (a) install under manifest id (org.sysc.timer), or (b) document that coexistence with catalog installs is unsupported. Verified still open 2026-09-29 against main @ 17e757c: Makefile:31 uses short $dir; no doc note found in README/Makefile/docs. Note: issue #12's other item (N2 tag==manifest release gate) is already fixed in release.yml (Verify manifest version step in build job, release needs: build).

title: screen-recorder: TestRecorderRepeatedToggleDoesNotRestart flaky under parallel load
description: Failed once during `make test` (go test -race ./...): recorder_test.go:77 mode = recording, want idle. Passes standalone 3/3. The test toggles record off then on in quick succession and assumes the second toggle lands while the stop is still in flight; under load the stop can complete first, so the toggle legitimately starts a new recording. Make the test deterministic (synchronise on the stop transition) rather than relying on timing.

title: [kdeconnect] suppress repeated background SFTP mount failures
description: GitHub issue #160: Phone Connect retries failed sftp.mountAndWait calls on every refresh (30s default), triggering repeated KDE Connect desktop notifications while the phone is not responding. Suppress automatic retries until a manual refresh, device selection/settings change, or device reconnect; preserve explicit Browse failure feedback. Cover the retry suppression with a regression check.

title: Render and eyeball every ThinkPad panel state via sysc-panel-preview
description: The panel has never been visually verified - only shelllint geometry checks. sysc-shell ships cmd/sysc-panel-preview which paints a v1.Node tree to PNG using the host's own validator, layout and painter, explicitly for catalog screenshots.
design:
1. Move the 8 state fixtures out of view_test.go into plugins/thinkpad/states.go as exported ExampleStates(), so tests and tooling share one source of truth.
2. New cmd/sysc-thinkpad-screenshot: writes <name>.json for each state, and <name>.png when -preview points at a sysc-panel-preview binary.
3. Makefile target 'thinkpad-screenshots'.
4. LOOK at every PNG and fix what is actually wrong - clipping, ragged spacing, cramped cards, wrong icon choice, unreadable contrast.
acceptance_criteria: PNGs exist for all states, each has been visually reviewed, and every layout defect found has been fixed and re-verified. Also produces the community-catalog screenshot.

title: Protocol-level integration test for the ThinkPad plugin process
description: cmd/sysc-plugin-thinkpad/main.go run() is untested. No plugin in this repo tests its process loop, so nothing has ever exercised the plugin against real host message ordering: Handshake, ViewOpen before/after SettingsChanged, ScopeInstance, panel entry switching, ViewClose, HostShutdown.
design: Drive run() over in-memory pipes. Script a full session: handshake, ViewOpen(bar), ViewOpen(panel), SettingsChanged(plugin scope), SettingsChanged(instance scope), InputEvent(open/settings/back/close), ViewClose, HostShutdown. Assert: every open view receives a snapshot, rev increments monotonically, panel entry switches settings<->panel, ViewClose stops publishing, shutdown returns cleanly with no goroutine leak. Watch for nil deref on unexpected ordering and for publishes to a closed view.
acceptance_criteria: A scripted session passes: no panic, no leaked goroutine, snapshots for each live view, correct panel entry switching, clean shutdown.

title: Write plugins/thinkpad/README.md - user-facing setup and troubleshooting
description: The plugin has a working setup path (the panel's Copy fix button emits a script covering modprobe fan_control=1, the sysc-thinkpad group and udev rules) but it is only reachable from inside the UI. A ThinkPad owner needs it in the repo before they install.
design: Cover: what the plugin controls and on which models; the permission setup and why it is needed; profile semantics (active profile seeds on load, direct toggles fold back into it); the built-in kernel gotcha where fan_control=1 cannot take effect until reboot; the group/re-login caveat for long-running sessions; troubleshooting notes for absent tpacpi::thinklight and the EIO on brightness_hw_changed.
acceptance_criteria: README explains install, the setup fix, profiles, and the known machine-specific quirks, and matches the setupScript the plugin ships.

title: Fold the fan level ladder into sysc-thinkpad-probe as an opt-in diagnostic
description: A throwaway script measured the real RPM curve on the testbench: levels 0 and 1 are LOUDER than level 2 (3378/3177 vs 2973 RPM), and RPM is monotonic only from 2 upward. The quietest level is model specific and must not be hardcoded, but every user should be able to measure their own.
design: Add -fan-ladder to cmd/sysc-thinkpad-probe: walk every level the kernel advertises, settle, read speed and level, print the curve, restore the starting level via an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. Read-only default is unchanged; the ladder is opt-in and never wired to a test.
acceptance_criteria: A user can measure their own machine's fan curve with one command, and the machine is restored to the level it started at.

title: Publish the ThinkPad plugin release and generate its catalog entry
description: make catalog-validate requires every row to have a published GitHub release tag whose manifest agrees on name/description/protocol/capabilities, plus asset URLs, sha256 and size. The entry is generated by the release workflow, so it cannot be written before the release exists.
design: Needs a user decision on version and timing. After tagging: go run ./tools/catalog update -tag thinkpad-v<ver> -dist <dir>, then make catalog-validate. Also needs a community screenshot, which the screenshot task produces.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entry generated and make catalog-validate passes, including -fetch against the real tag.

title: Use sysc-shell protocol 1.17 and verify ThinkPad on the laptop testbench
description: The merged shell and plugin deployment are complete, and the ThinkPad plugin is installed and enabled in the laptop bar. Direct SSH probes read live metrics and pass reversible LED and fan write/restore checks. The plugin process reports read-only because the lingering systemd user manager lacks the sysc-thinkpad supplementary group. Refresh that manager, then verify live plugin controls and profile replay.
design: After the sysc-shell protocol change is merged, pin that revision in go.mod, prove a regular build without GOWORK, deploy the merged shell through its deploy script, install the ThinkPad plugin and check the wordmark, telemetry, sliders, toggles, and saved profile on hardware. Keep the optional fan ladder opt-in.
acceptance_criteria: The plugin builds without a workspace override, the deployed testbench accepts the manifest, left and right BAR clicks open the panel, telemetry reads live, and controlled fan/LED changes and profile restore work.
